1: // Simple endless side‑scroller based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // --- Graphics enhancements ---
6:   // Background gradient and simple clouds for parallax effect
7:   const clouds = [];
8:   const CLOUD_COUNT = 5;
9:   for (let i = 0; i < CLOUD_COUNT; i++) {
10:     clouds.push({
11:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
12:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height * 0.3,
13:       r: 20 + Math.random() * 30,
14:       speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
15:     });
16:   }
17: 
18:   function drawBackground() {
19:     // Sky gradient
20:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
21:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue top
22:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#b0e0e6'); // lighter near horizon
23:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
24:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
25:     // Draw clouds
26:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
27:     for (const c of clouds) {
28:       ctx.beginPath();
29:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
30:       ctx.fill();
31:       // move cloud left for parallax
32:       c.x -= c.speed;
33:       if (c.x + c.r < 0) c.x = WIDTH + c.r;
34:     }
35:   }
36: 
37:   // End of graphics enhancements
38: 
39:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
40:   // Audio setup
41:   let audioCtx = null;
42:   function initAudio(){
43:     if (!audioCtx) {
44:       audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
45:     }
46:   }
47:   function playTone(freq, duration){
48:     if (!audioCtx) return;
49:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
50:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
51:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
52:     osc.type = 'sine';
53:     osc.connect(gain);
54:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
55:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
56:     osc.start();
57:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
58:   }
59:   // const canvas = document.getElementById('game'); // duplicate removed
60:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
61:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
62:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
63:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
64: 
65:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
66:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
67:   const SPEED = 3;
68: 
69:   const player = {
70:     w: 30,
71:     h: 30,
72:     x: 50,
73:     y: HEIGHT - 80,
74:     vy: 0,
75:     onGround: true,
76:     draw() {
77:       // Player gradient rectangle with rounded corners
78:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.h);
79:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0af');
80:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#005');
81:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
82:       const radius = 5;
83:       ctx.beginPath();
84:       ctx.moveTo(this.x + radius, this.y);
85:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w - radius, this.y);
86:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.w, this.y, this.x + this.w, this.y + radius);
87:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h - radius);
88:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h, this.x + this.w - radius, this.y + this.h);
89:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + radius, this.y + this.h);
90:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h, this.x, this.y + this.h - radius);
91:       ctx.lineTo(this.x, this.y + radius);
92:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y, this.x + radius, this.y);
93:       ctx.closePath();
94:       ctx.fill();
95:     },
96:     update() {
97:       this.vy += GRAVITY;
98:       this.y += this.vy;
99:       if (this.y + this.h >= groundY) {
100:         this.y = groundY - this.h;
101:         this.vy = 0;
102:         this.onGround = true;
103:       } else {
104:         this.onGround = false;
105:       }
106:     },
107:     jump() {
108:       // Ensure audio context is ready
109:       initAudio();
110:       // Play jump sound
111:       playTone(660, 0.08);
112:       if (this.onGround) {
113:         this.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
114:         this.onGround = false;
115:       }
116:     },
117:   };
118: 
119:   const groundY = HEIGHT - 50;
120:   const obstacles = [];
121:   let frame = 0;
122:   let gameOver = false;
123: 
124:   function spawnObstacle() {
125:     // Randomly spawn a spike or a gap (gap represented by a longer floor skip)
126:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
127:     const x = WIDTH + 20;
128:     if (type === 'spike') {
129:       obstacles.push({ type: 'spike', x, y: groundY - 20, w: 20, h: 20 });
130:     } else {
131:       // gap: just push a marker; when player reaches it, floor disappears for a short span
132:       obstacles.push({ type: 'gap', x, width: 80, passed: false });
133:     }
134:   }
135: 
136:   function updateObstacles() {
137:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
138:       const o = obstacles[i];
139:       o.x -= SPEED;
140:       // Remove off‑screen
141:       if (o.x + (o.w || o.width) < -20) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
142:     }
143:     // Spawn new obstacles every 120 frames
144:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
145:   }
146: 
147:   function drawFloor() {
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
149:     // Determine if a gap covers current floor segment
150:     let gapActive = false;
151:     for (const o of obstacles) {
152:       if (o.type === 'gap' && o.x < WIDTH && o.x + o.width > 0) {
153:         // Draw floor before gap
154:         ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, o.x, 10);
155:         // Skip drawing over gap, then draw remainder after gap
156:         ctx.fillRect(o.x + o.width, groundY, WIDTH - (o.x + o.width), 10);
157:         gapActive = true;
158:         break;
159:       }
160:     }
161:     if (!gapActive) ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, WIDTH, 10);
162:   }
163: 
164:   function drawObstacles() {
165:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a00';
166:     for (const o of obstacles) {
167:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
168:         ctx.beginPath();
169:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
170:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
171:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
172:         ctx.closePath();
173:         ctx.fill();
174:       }
175:     }
176:   }
177: 
178:   function checkCollision() {
179:     for (const o of obstacles) {
180:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
181:         const hit =
182:           player.x < o.x + o.w &&
183:           player.x + player.w > o.x &&
184:           player.y < o.y + o.h &&
185:           player.y + player.h > o.y;
186:         if (hit) return true;
187:       }
188:       if (o.type === 'gap') {
189:         // Gap collision handled by floor missing; if player is falling below ground while over gap
190:         const overGap = player.x + player.w > o.x && player.x < o.x + o.width;
191:         if (overGap && player.y + player.h >= groundY) {
192:           // Player is on missing floor
193:           return true;
194:         }
195:       }
196:     }
197:     return false;
198:   }
199: 
200:   function loop() {
201:     if (gameOver) {
202:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
203:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
204:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
205:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
206:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2 - 60, HEIGHT / 2);
207:       return;
208:     }
209:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
210:     drawBackground();
211:     drawFloor();
212:     player.update();
213:     player.draw();
214:     updateObstacles();
215:     drawObstacles();
216:     const collided = checkCollision();
217:     if (collided) {
218:       // Ensure audio context
219:       initAudio();
220:       // Play collision sound
221:       playTone(200, 0.2);
222:       gameOver = true;
223:     }
224:     frame++;
225:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
226:   }
227: 
228:   // Input
229:   window.addEventListener('click', () => player.jump());
230:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.code === 'Space') player.jump(); });
231: 
232:   // Start
233:   loop();
234: })();

(End of file - total 234 lines)
